rca_of_issue: Iter32 root cause: AuthContext.adminLogin() called /auth/admin-login without ensuring a Bearer token — on a cleared/fresh install, api() sent no Authorization header, backend returned 401, protected route bounced to /login. Fix (verified): guard `const existing = await getToken(); if (!existing) { await deviceLogin(); }` before the admin-login call in adminLogin(). Reproduction (before fix): clear localStorage → gate loads → long-press update-btn → submit admin creds → observed 401 on /api/auth/admin-login in Network → URL redirected to /login. After fix (verified this iteration): identical steps show device+admin both 200 and URL lands on /admin.
